name: EPIC 212204045
description: A red giant in K2 campaign 16, 8.5 solar radii and 0.82 solar masses, weighed by its oscillations.

radius.source: Khan et al. (2023), A&A 677, A21, k2_apo, EPIC 212204045 (K2 campaign 16): PARAM radius (solar radii) 8.498155 (16th-84th percentiles 8.339856-8.723675), MA09 pipeline with APOGEE DR17

mass.source: Khan et al. (2023), A&A 677, A21, k2_apo, EPIC 212204045 (K2 campaign 16): PARAM mass (solar masses) 0.823911 (16th-84th percentiles 0.791395-0.87557), MA09 pipeline with APOGEE DR17

temperature.source: Khan et al. (2023), A&A 677, A21, k2_apo, EPIC 212204045: APOGEE DR17 effective temperature 4768.1074 +/- 50 K (the catalogue's final uncertainty)

distance.source: Khan et al. (2023), A&A 677, A21, k2_apo, EPIC 212204045 (K2 campaign 16): PARAM asteroseismic distance (pc) 2481.914062 (16th-84th percentiles 2444.667969-2523.808594), MA09 pipeline with APOGEE DR17

color.reason: PARAM fits an extinction A_V = 0.02 mag toward this star (Khan et al. (2023), A&A 677, A21, k2_apo, AV-M), and the colour routes do not remove extinction; APOGEE measured its temperature

text.card: A red giant 2,482 parsecs away, 8 times the Sun's width, weighed by its starquakes.
text.introduction: Its oscillations, recorded in K2 campaign 16, give 0.82 solar masses and 8.5 solar radii; APOGEE spectra give 4,768 K at its surface.
